state.summary: Some users express excitement about renewing their Netflix subscriptions to watch various shows and movies. Several tweets describe relaxing at home alone or with friends while binge-watching content like South Park and The Walking Dead, though one user notes they no longer have access to these titles. A few individuals complain about technical issues such as the app not loading or having trouble finding specific titles. Others mention sharing passwords, trading accounts, or feeling annoyed when others try to use their Netflix profiles without permission. Some users also note that they prefer Netflix over traditional TV due to a lack of commercials and better content variety.
